title: Voya expands access on its Retirement platform to new CIT funds that invest in actively managed investment strategies
summary: Lower-cost access to active management from recognized managers, recommended by Voya Investment Management’s multi-asset team
body_markdown:
**Lower-cost access to active management from recognized managers, recommended by Voya Investment Management’s multi-asset team**


WINDSOR, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Voya Financial (NYSE: VOYA) today announced the launch of eight new collective investment trust (CIT) funds trusteed by Great Gray Trust Company, LLC. (Great Gray). Voya Investment Management (Voya IM) is serving as the non-discretionary investment sub-advisor to the funds. Based on a comparison of expense ratios between the mutual fund version of the underlying investment held by the CIT, as identified by MorningStar direct, the new CITs provide a more cost-effective means to access active management strategies from recognized investment firms.1


CITs have grown in popularity in DC plans, primarily due to fee flexibility and lower cost structures. “Employers and advisors want investment choices from names they trust, at a price that is competitive for participants,” said Allison Dirksen, head of Retirement Distribution, Voya Financial. “Working with Great Gray and Voya Investment Management, we’re delivering that.”


Voya IM’s Multi-Asset Strategies and Solutions (MASS) team will oversee the underlying fund and manager recommendations, drawing on the experience of Voya’s Manager Research & Selection team. Great Gray retains full authority over final investment decisions, implementation, and ongoing changes. Initially, the funds will be available on Voya’s Retirement platform to eligible plans and advisors.


“The investment solutions we help bring to market have the potential to make a meaningful difference in participants’ long-term financial outcomes,” said Barbara Reinhard, Chief Investment Officer, Multi-Asset Strategies and Solutions, Voya Investment Management. “By bringing together the investment experience of Voya Investment Management and the retirement insights of Voya Retirement, we’re expanding access to cost-effective investment choices designed to help more participants build toward a more secure retirement.”


**Great Gray is not affiliated with the Voya family of companies**


Great Gray Trust Company, LLC serves as Trustee for these bank collective investment funds (“Funds”) and maintains ultimate fiduciary authority over the management of, and investments made in, the Funds. Voya Investment Management Co., LLC is a registered investment adviser that has been hired by the Trustee to assist it in managing the Funds. The Funds are not mutual funds as the Funds and their units are exempt from registration under the Investment Company Act of 1940 and the Securities Act of 1933, respectively.


**Investments in the Funds are not bank deposits or obligations of and are not insured or guaranteed by Great Gray Trust Company, LLC, any bank, the FDIC, the Federal Reserve, or any other governmental agency. The Funds are commingled investment vehicles, and as such, the values of the underlying investments will rise and fall according to market activity; it is possible to lose money by investing in the Funds.**


The Funds are only available to eligible qualified retirement plans and certain state or local government plans that satisfy the trust’s eligibility requirements and complete the participation materials required by Great Gray. The Funds are not available to the general public. Collective Investment Trust Funds may be suitable investments for plan fiduciaries seeking to construct a well-diversified retirement savings program. Investors should consider the investment objectives, risks, charges, and expenses of any pooled investment fund carefully before investing.


Great Gray® and Great Gray Trust Company are service marks used in connection with various fiduciary and non-fiduciary services offered by Great Gray Trust Company, LLC.
